definitions.reference: Archived M6 G0 prior geometry, fixed accepted mask, archived D3 eps/slow/support
definitions.causal_window: Current packet plus accepted past within10s and at most100 past, based on archived baseline motion
definitions.kernel_counts: N_w=sum current-past rho. N_eff=N^2/sum over all window rho_ij. Report both separately.
definitions.interpretation: Kernel counts use the already frozen length scales, not independently fitted RF correlations. Sensitivity-square products are scalar-heading local exposure proxies, not full pose Fisher information.

population: accepted AND D3-supported; raw-only accepted population additionally reported
kernel_history: all accepted history regardless of current distance bin; current packet included
R_ref: archived G0 Reff_ss; G0 is E0-LORO-sigma_b, not original E0
